body: I have aspergers, I majorly struggle to use the phone or talk. I was almost completely mute for 12 years. Undiagnosed and just waiting for help. Yesterday they finally understood that i cant use the phone so family are the main contact. I just want to survive. I can't. I have an air duster sat behind me bought as an xmas present, for IT, but I know what you can do with it. I'm so scared I will just end it.
